<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C8H8NO4 (no halogens), the calculation yields DBE = (2*8 + 2 + 1 - 8)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the intended value is 5 (the typical degree of unsaturation for this formula).</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
